messages:
Bob (Support): 09:12 UTC — multiple customers reporting 5xx + timeouts on hosted inference /v1/generate. Spike started ~09:08. Lots of retries hitting gateway.
Carla (SRE): seeing elevated 502/504 from hosted-gateway; correlated with increases in authz errors and authz latency spiking.
Dana (Infra): authz-service shows KMS throttle errors and cache fills -> fallback to remote check. We deployed a config change to authz-cache last night; need to confirm values.
Ed (Tech Ops): customer logs show repeated client retries 3x leading to request storm. header: `x-client-retries: 3`.
Carla (SRE): quick snippet from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-17T09:10:22Z gateway: upstream authz timeout: context deadline exceeded
upstream call: https://authz.redwood.internal/validate
request_id=01FJZ2... user=acct-123
```
Dana (Infra): starting canary: increasing authz-cache TTL from 5s -> 30s in svc-authz-canary (09:16 UTC).
Frank (Eng): can we reduce amplification by throttling retry behavior at the edge? I can open a short-lived patch to add exponential backoff and cap immediate retries.
Bob (Support): Customers A & B impacted; one is running bulk evals and is hitting 503 repeatedly. They're asking for ETA.
Ed (Tech Ops): initiating rolling restart of gateway workers to drop any stuck connections / conn-pool backpressure — started 09:18 UTC.
Carla (SRE): mitigation checklist: 1) authz-cache TTL canary 2) edge retry cap 3) temporary routing to lighter-model fallback for high-latency requests 4) customer comms.
Dana (Infra): canary metrics: authz p95 latency dropped ~60% within 90s after TTL bump. Pushing TTL change to prod now (09:20 UTC).
Frank (Eng): PR for short-term circuit-breaker on authz (open after 5 failures for 30s): https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/483 — scheduling deploy to prod after quick review.
Bob (Support): I'll message impacted customers with current mitigations and offer temporary quota bump / dedicated path while we stabilize.
Carla (SRE): note: need to understand why TTL was lowered in prior deploy (was intended to reduce staleness for recent policy changes). We'll add deploy gating for authz-cache config.
Frank (Eng): proposed action items:
- FRK-1: revert unintended config drift and add CI validation for authz-cache values (owner: Frank, ETA 2h)
- CAR-2: run controlled load repro to validate retry amplification and measure thresholds (owner: Carla, ETA 4h)
- DANA-3: add metric + alert for authz fallback rate and KMS throttle errors (owner: Dana, ETA 6h)
- BOB-4: customer comms + ticket updates for impacted accounts (owner: Bob, ETA 30m)
Carla (SRE): marking incident mitigated at 09:22 UTC — traffic normalized, 5xx rate back to baseline. We'll schedule a postmortem doc and link it in #incidents-postmortems.
Bob (Support): thanks everyone :thumbsup: — will follow up with customer notes once I finish the template.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-17-1735823456 recorded, severity=P2, status=mitigated, follow-up required.
Carla (SRE): closing thread here; postmortem owners: Frank + Carla.
Bob (Support): on it, will attach customer timelines and logs in the postmortem. :heart:
